name: 2018 Pre-K School Directory
description:
This dataset is a directory of pre-kindergarten programs available in New York City for the 2018 school year. Each of the roughly 1,800 rows represents a single pre-K program or school site, identified by a school code (DBRN) and described across 85 columns covering location, contact details, program offerings, and admissions policies.

The data includes each site's name, full address, borough, school district, program type, phone number, contact name and email, and website. It also records practical details such as whether meals are provided, outdoor play space, uniform requirements, single-gender status, and up to three named programs with their codes. A large set of columns describes admissions priorities—for example, how seats are allocated to current students, siblings, district residents, and out-of-district applicants—along with indicators for dual-language or enhanced-language programs, special education notes, and accessibility. Additional fields cover logistics like half-day options, bus service, nearby subway stops,
